# Forex: REST API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-26 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

20 REST endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Aggregates

### Custom Bars (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/ticker/{forexTicker}/range/{multiplier}/{timespan}/{from}/{to}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/aggregates/custom-bars.md)

Retrieve aggregated historical OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified Forex currency pair over a custom date range and time interval in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

- **Params:** `forexTicker`\*, `multiplier`\*, `timespan`\*, `from`\*, `to`\*, `adjusted`, `sort`, `limit`
- **Returns:** `ticker adjusted queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `c h l n o t v vw`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter Real-time · history Basic 2y · Starter all

### Daily Market Summary (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/grouped/locale/global/market/fx/{date}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/aggregates/daily-market-summary.md)

Retrieve daily OHLC (open, high, low, close), volume, and volume-weighted average price (VWAP) data for all forex tickers on a specified trading date.

- **Params:** `date`\*, `adjusted`
- **Returns:** `adjusted queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `T c h l n o t v vw`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter Real-time · history Basic 2y · Starter all

### Previous Day Bar (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/ticker/{forexTicker}/prev` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/aggregates/previous-day-bar.md)

Retrieve the previous trading day's open, high, low, and close (OHLC) data for a specified forex pair.

- **Params:** `forexTicker`\*, `adjusted`
- **Returns:** `ticker adjusted queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `T c h l n o t v vw`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter Real-time

## Currency Conversion

### Currency Conversion

`GET /v1/conversion/{from}/{to}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/currency-conversion.md)

Retrieve real-time currency conversion rates between any two supported currencies.

- **Params:** `from`\*, `to`\*, `amount`, `precision`
- **Returns:** `converted from initialAmount last symbol to` · last: `ask bid exchange timestamp`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

## Market Operations

### Exchanges

`GET /v3/reference/exchanges` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/market-operations/exchanges.md)

Retrieve a list of known exchanges, including their identifiers, names, market types, and other relevant attributes.

- **Params:** `asset_class`, `locale`
- **Returns:** results[]: `acronym asset_class id locale mic name operating_mic participant_id type url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Starter Updated as needed

### Market Holidays

`GET /v1/marketstatus/upcoming` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/market-operations/market-holidays.md)

Retrieve upcoming market holidays and their corresponding open/close times.

- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Starter Updated as needed

### Market Status

`GET /v1/marketstatus/now` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/market-operations/market-status.md)

Retrieve the current trading status for various exchanges and overall financial markets.

- **Returns:** `afterHours currencies earlyHours exchanges indicesGroups market serverTime` · currencies: `crypto fx` · exchanges: `nasdaq nyse otc` · indicesGroups: `cccy cgi dow_jones ftse_russell msci mstar mstarc nasdaq s_and_p societe_generale`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Starter Updated in real time

## Quotes

### Last Quote

`GET /v1/last_quote/currencies/{from}/{to}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/quotes/last-quote.md)

Retrieve the most recent quote for a specified forex currency pair, including bid, ask, exchange, and timestamp.

- **Params:** `from`\*, `to`\*
- **Returns:** `last symbol` · last: `ask bid exchange timestamp`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Quotes

`GET /v3/quotes/{fxTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/quotes/quotes.md)

Retrieve historical Best Bid and Offer (BBO) quotes for a specified forex currency pair over a defined time range.

- **Params:** `fxTicker`\*, `timestamp` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `ask_exchange ask_price bid_exchange bid_price participant_timestamp` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time · history Starter all

## Snapshots

### Full Market Snapshot

`GET /v2/snapshot/locale/global/markets/forex/tickers` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/snapshots/full-market-snapshot.md)

Retrieve a comprehensive snapshot of the forex market in a single response.

- **Params:** `tickers`
- **Returns:** `tickers` · tickers[]: `day fmv lastQuote min prevDay ticker todaysChange todaysChangePerc updated`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Single Ticker Snapshot

`GET /v2/snapshot/locale/global/markets/forex/tickers/{ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/snapshots/single-ticker-snapshot.md)

Retrieve the most recent market data snapshot for a single ticker.

- **Params:** `ticker`\*
- **Returns:** `ticker` · ticker: `day fmv lastQuote min prevDay ticker todaysChange todaysChangePerc updated`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Top Market Movers

`GET /v2/snapshot/locale/global/markets/forex/{direction}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/snapshots/top-market-movers.md)

Retrieve snapshot data highlighting the top 20 gainers or losers in the forex market.

- **Params:** `direction`\*
- **Returns:** `tickers` · tickers[]: `day fmv lastQuote min prevDay ticker todaysChange todaysChangePerc updated`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Unified Snapshot

`GET /v3/snapshot` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/snapshots/unified-snapshot.md)

Retrieve unified snapshots of market data for multiple asset classes including stocks, options, forex, and cryptocurrencies in a single request.

- **Params:** `ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt .any_of), `type`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `error fmv fmv_last_updated last_minute last_quote market_status message name session ticker type` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

## Tickers

### All Tickers

`GET /v3/reference/tickers` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/tickers/all-tickers.md)

Retrieve a comprehensive list of ticker symbols supported by Massive across various asset classes (e.g., stocks, indices, forex, crypto).

- **Params:** `ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `type`, `market`, `exchange`, `cusip`, `cik`, `date`, `search`, `active`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `active base_currency_name base_currency_symbol cik composite_figi currency_name currency_symbol delisted_utc last_updated_utc locale market name primary_exchange share_class_figi ticker type` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Starter Updated hourly · history Basic 2y · Starter all

### Ticker Overview

`GET /v3/reference/tickers/{ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/tickers/ticker-overview.md)

Retrieve comprehensive details for a single ticker supported by Massive that is active as-of a given date.

- **Params:** `ticker`\*, `date`
- **Returns:** results: `active address branding cik composite_figi currency_name delisted_utc description homepage_url list_date locale market market_cap name phone_number primary_exchange round_lot share_class_figi share_class_shares_outstanding sic_code sic_description ticker ticker_root ticker_suffix total_employees type weighted_shares_outstanding`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Starter Updated hourly · history Basic 2y · Starter all

### Ticker Types

`GET /v3/reference/tickers/types` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/tickers/ticker-types.md)

Retrieve a list of all ticker types supported by Massive.

- **Params:** `asset_class`, `locale`
- **Returns:** results[]: `asset_class code description locale`
- **Plan:** add-on: see docs
